name: skyvern

SKYVERN_API_KEY.description: Skyvern API key for the cloud or self-hosted backend.

SKYVERN_BASE_URL.description: Skyvern API base URL. Defaults to https://api.skyvern.com.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Required for self-hosted runs that use OpenAI as the vision/LLM backend.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Required for self-hosted runs that use Anthropic as the vision/LLM backend.

notes: Computer-vision driven browser agent. Defaults to MONITOR — every navigation/click is surfaced to the operator since the agent can authenticate, transact, and submit forms. WebArena: 31.4 (2026-02-12). AGPL-3.0 — review license before bundling into closed deployments.
